title: Spindle thermal protection
text: Alarm E417 trips when spindle winding temperature exceeds 85 degrees C. Check cooling fan operation, intake filters and the thermal sensor connector before replacing the motor.
author: OEM

title: Spindle vibration checks
text: Alarm V310 indicates vibration above limit. Inspect tool holder seating and taper cleanliness first, then spindle bearings. Bearing replacement requires spindle removal.
author: OEM

title: Hydraulic system
text: Normal operating pressure is 180 bar. Alarm H220 means pressure dropped below 150 bar during stroke. Inspect cylinder seals, oil level and filter condition.
author: OEM

title: Belt tensioning procedure
text: Tension the belt to 1 percent elongation measured between marks 1 m apart. Under-tensioned belts slip under load and trigger alarm C050. Recheck tension after 48 hours of running.
author: OEM

title: Belt tracking
text: Alarm C071 indicates the belt drifting off-center. Adjust idler alignment in small steps and observe tracking over several full belt rotations.
author: OEM

title: Coolant pump service
text: Low flow with grinding noise, alarm P611, usually indicates impeller damage. Fit an inlet strainer to prevent debris. Mechanical seal leaks are reported as P615.
author: OEM

title: Air compressor alarms
text: A120 high discharge temperature: check intake filter and cooler fins. A130 pressure not building: inspect the unloader valve and check for air leaks.
author: OEM
